newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - HK newspaper headlines - Oct 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Hong Kong press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- EXPRESS DAILY -- When Chief Executive contender C.H. Tung's business was in difficulties in the 1980s, Beijing saved him by lending US$120 million through a pro-Beijing businessman, but Tung denied knowing the details of the loan.
-- HONG KONG ECONOMIC TIMES -- Chief Executive contender C.H. Tung said he had received the blessing of Beijing and said he hoped Chief Secretary Anson Chan would stay on at her post.
-- Beijing-funded WEN WEI PO -- China plans to strengthen cooperation with international space technology organisations, and plans to send astronauts to Russian for training next year.
-- SING TAO DAILY -- China has come up with a plan to make its own aircraft carrier in the beginning of the next century.
-- English-language SOUTH CHINA MORNING POST -- Beijing units in Hong Kong had been asked to help boost the authority and prestige of President Jiang Zemnn in the territory.

-- China National Aviation Corp had acquired a mailand passenger carrier, further sharpening CNAC's power to dominate flights linking the mainland with Hong Kong and Macau and future connections with Taiwan.

-- English-language HONGKONG STANDARD -- A report by First Pacific Davies showed that Hong Kong East had emerged as an established business district with more Grade A office stock than either Wanchai-Causeway Bay or Tsim Sha Tsui.
